svg.aria-label: Left, what the agent cannot return. Contact phone and email: Dataverse column security, the profile Contact Phone Protection, secures the phone columns from the start and Task 6.1 adds the email column, so get_customer_contacts returns no phone or email. A card number in an internal note of TCK-10521: the Microsoft Purview DLP policy for Credit Card Number blocks it and the result says withheld_by_policy. The document Woodgrove-Bank-Secure-Gateway-configuration.docx is labeled Relecloud Confidential: the MCP server's label check refuses it with CONTENT_BLOCKED_BY_LABEL. Right, the trail of one action in Task 6.3: C:\LabFiles\tools\Get-ActionTrail.ps1 takes the correlation ID 0b6f3c9e-6d2a-4f55-9a43-2d7c1e8b5a10 and finds it in Application Insights (the agent's request and tool decision), the API Management gateway log, the MCP server log (authorization result and backend call), the Dataverse audit record of TCK-10544 changing from P4 Low to P3 Medium, the Agent Action row, and the outcome returned to the agent.
